title: The Complete Recordings
notes:
Vocalion circle on front of box states 'Full-Range Recording All 41 Recordings Of Robert Johnson'

Mono Recordings, digitally restored and remastered.

Includes a 11.25" x 5.5" 48 page booklet with lyrics, credits and some biographical notes about Robert Johnson, alongside essays by Eric Clapton and Keith Richards.

Also includes a 'Roots n' Blues' advertising sheet.

Runouts are etched, except "D" is stamped.
"C 46761" is located on the record labels.
"C3 46222" is located on the front of the box and record labels.
